Noah (PM): Quick decision thread: finalize pin TTL, perf lanes, and minimal canary rollback rules so we can lock the roadmap card.

Noah (PM): Proposal: default pin TTL 30d, enterprise opt-in 180d with migration credits; perf lanes short/med/long; canary rule = 3-of-4 canaries breach for 10m => auto-fallback.

Rina (Eng Runtime): Agree but suggest TTL 45d default to reduce churn. Also make lane thresholds explicit: short p95 <300ms, med p95 <600ms, long p95 <1s.

Diego (Applied ML): For onboarding gates: require probe set pass + tenant sample (min 150 prompts) or manual signoff. Add embedding median cosine >=0.986.

Ivy (CS): Customers ask for 1-year pins for audits. We can offer contract addendum and a self-serve renewal request with 48h SLA.

Kara (Legal): Can draft addendum. Need migration and liability language. Also require export snapshot process for audit pins.

lifecycle-bot: ACTIONS: ENG spike canary engine (2sprints), ML deliver eval harness (1 sprint), CS+Legal draft addendum (1 sprint).

Noah (PM): OK agreed to compromise: default TTL 45d, enterprise opt-in 365d with credits and quarterly migration review; 3-of-4 canary rollback rule stands. I'll write RFC.
